newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Roslyn starts as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Roslyn starts as neutral.

text.p: -- First Albany Corporation Inc said on Monday it had started coverage of Roslyn Bancorp with a rating of neutral.
-- Roslyn launched an initial public offering on Monday and its shares rose in the first day of trade. They closed up five at 15 on volume of 16 million shares.

-- "Based on a price of 115 to 120 percent of book (value), the shares look mildly attractive (pro forma book is $13.60), but the (price/earnings ratio) of 16.7x at $14.50 is four multiples above New York area comparables," analyst Kevin Timmons wrote in a report.

-- "Longer term, effective deployment of the capital base could result in significant earnings increases, which could drive the shares higher, but it will take several years of good growth to justify a material move."
-- "... We have instituted tentative (earnings-per-share) estimates of $0.87 and $1.00" for fiscal 1997 and 1998, respectively, Timmons wrote.
